parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description:
Personal access token.  
This field is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair (AK+SK) or temporary credentials from Security Token Service (STS).

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The enterprise identifier, also known as the organization ID, is a string that can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access URL, such as https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The file path within the code repository. Specifies the folder whose contents you want to retrieve. By default, the entire structure of the repository's file tree is retrieved.

parameters.name: refName
parameters.description: The branch name, tag name, or commit ID. Defaults to the repository's default branch.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description:
The search strategy:  
DIRECT: Lists only the contents of the current folder.  
RECURSIVE: Recursively retrieves all files under the current path.  
FLATTEN: Flattens the structure (if the path is a folder, recursively traverses it until subdirectories contain files or multiple folders).
